claim.statement: For the exact target-valid circular family A_m with nonzero spectrum {-1,1,1}, every exact representation through three disjoint original-coordinate scalar banks has sigma_min(K)<=18/m if all banks are residual, and sigma_min(K)<=12/m if the exact-zero hub is active. Any exact residual bank represented by a linear statistic of dimension at most two contains at most two residual coordinates.

actual_mathematical_premises: Circular residual rows v_j=m^(-1/2)(1,sqrt(2)cos(2pi j/m),sqrt(2)sin(2pi j/m)) form a Parseval frame.
Every three distinct circular residual rows are linearly independent, so every residual 3x3 principal block is nonsingular because D_m is invertible.
Residual entries satisfy |A_ij|<=3/m; A_00=0; A_0j=0 implies A_jj=2/m.

partner_result_applied.scope: Three pairwise disjoint original-coordinate scalar banks with exact active form S^T K S+ell^T S+c and sigma_min(K)>=s imply ||p_Q||_infinity<296/s.
partner_result_applied.application: On the circular family, exact scalar-bank representations necessarily have sigma_min(K)=O(1/m), so this theorem cannot furnish a dimension-free certificate there.

primary_source.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), arXiv:1507.07949, Theorem 1.1
primary_source.scope: For product probability densities, cap-one one-dimensional factors give k-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=2^(k/2); no moments, support, log-concavity, smoothness, iid, symmetry or centering; no projected-coordinate independence.

required_pinned_result_applied.application: For the exact circular {-1,1,1} family, p_Q(t)<=pi sqrt(2) for a.e. t>=0; the remaining obstruction is confined to the negative/two-sheet side.

unresolved_implication.statement: Uniformly bound the negative/two-sheet density of the circular family while preserving a genuinely three-dimensional residual product statistic, or use an equivalent coupled oscillatory/product-preserving mechanism. Exact scalar and exact 2D bank compression cannot aggregate enough residual coordinates.

next_step: Seek a source-matching theorem or prove an inequality for a three-dimensional linear image of a cap-one product law that controls the minority two-sheet quadratic trace using simultaneous linear-product provenance, not only bounded joint/marginal/X-ray densities.
